schemes.name: Charity grants
schemes.gives: One-off grants for things like bills, essentials, a deposit or a crisis, from charities that help people directly.
schemes.how: Many charity grants go through a support worker or adviser. Pick one that fits and read its rules first.
schemes.worthChecking: Each charity sets its own rules

rule.expr: on a low income, getting Universal Credit or Pension Credit, or behind on bills
